date.description: Session date YYYY-MM-DD, today through 6 days ahead

time.description: Local start time HH:MM in WAHOO_TIMEZONE (default Europe/Berlin)

name.description: Session name; with the date it forms the ID pbp-<date>-<name>

steps.description: Steps in order. A step without target is a free ride (RPE 1-10). Example: [{"name": "Einfahren", "minutes": 10, "percent_ftp": 0.55, "type": "warmup"}, {"repeat": 4, "steps": [{"minutes": 8, "percent_ftp": 0.9}, {"minutes": 4, "percent_ftp": 0.5, "type": "rest"}]}]

name.description: Step name shown on the ELEMNT

percent_ftp.description: Target as fraction of FTP, e.g. 0.65 (converted to watts)

percent_ftp_min.description: Lower bound of a target range as fraction of FTP

percent_ftp_max.description: Upper bound of a target range as fraction of FTP

watts.description: Absolute target in watts (instead of percent_ftp)

type.description: warmup, active (default), tempo, threshold, rest, recovery, cooldown

repeat.description: Makes this a repeat block: run steps this many times in total (2-30)

steps.description: Steps of a repeat block (no nesting beyond one level needed)

description.description: Shown on the ELEMNT; defaults to the name

session_id.description: Overrides the derived ID, e.g. pbp-2026-10-18-angels

ftp.description: FTP in watts; defaults to WAHOO_FTP or the Wahoo power zones

allow_outside_window.description: Push even outside today .. today + 6 days (devices will not receive it)
